rag_samples.question: What Docker concepts and features are covered in modern containerization workflows?
rag_samples.reference: It covers Docker images and containers, networking, volumes and storage, Docker Compose, registries, multi-stage builds, monitoring and logging, plus container lifecycle management.
relevant_contexts: The core concepts include Docker images, containers, networking, volume storage, Docker Compose, registries, multi-stage Docker builds, monitoring and logging.

rag_samples.question: Which automation topics and error-handling techniques are covered in shell scripting?
rag_samples.reference: The topic covers loops, user input, variables, ownership changes, cron jobs and automation, log extraction, networking, backups, file creation, project builds, and error handling using 'set -euo pipefail'.
relevant_contexts: Shell script loops, user input and variables, changing ownership, cron jobs and automation, extracting logs, networking, backups, file creation, project builds, and error handling.

rag_samples.question: Which Kubernetes workload, networking, and operations topics are essential for cluster management?
rag_samples.reference: Kubernetes features include Pods and namespaces; StatefulSets, DaemonSets, ReplicaSets, and CronJobs; networking, services, and Ingress; persistent storage; horizontal and vertical autoscaling; resource limits and probes; RBAC; and monitoring.
relevant_contexts: Pods and namespaces, StatefulSets, DaemonSets, ReplicaSets and CronJobs, networking, Services and Ingress, persistent volumes and storage classes, horizontal and vertical autoscaling, limits, probes, role-based access control, and monitoring.

rag_samples.question: What Jenkins pipeline and operations features are demonstrated in CI/CD workflows?
rag_samples.reference: It covers Jenkins setup on virtual machines or AWS, freestyle jobs, declarative pipelines, multi-agent and multi-node setups, shared libraries, role-based access, a CI/CD project, and email notifications when a pipeline fails.
relevant_contexts: Jenkins setup on virtual machines and AWS, the dashboard and jobs, freestyle projects, declarative pipelines, multi-agent and multi-node Jenkins, shared libraries, role-based access, a CI/CD project, and failure email notifications.

rag_samples.question: Which Argo CD deployment and security capabilities are covered in GitOps workflows?
rag_samples.reference: It covers GitOps principles, connecting Argo CD to providers, setting up Kind/EKS clusters, deploying applications through the UI, CLI, and declarative configuration, multi-cluster use, App of Apps, automation and notifications, plus RBAC, SSO, and HTTPS security.
relevant_contexts: GitOps principles, connecting Argo CD to providers, setting up clusters, creating applications through the UI and CLI or declaratively, multi-cluster use, App of Apps, automation, Slack and email notifications, RBAC, SSO, and HTTPS.

rag_samples.question: Which GitLab CI/CD project features are included in modern pipeline configurations?
rag_samples.reference: It covers CI/CD pipelines, pipeline variables and secrets, self-hosted and hosted runners, and deploying a project through a GitLab pipeline. It also introduces GitLab as a source-code repository and version-control platform with project-management features.
relevant_contexts: Pipeline variables and secrets, self-hosted and hosted runners, and deploying a project through CI/CD pipelines in GitLab, including repositories, source-code management, version control, and project-management capabilities.
